summary.name: Geany
summary.one_liner: Geany is a lightweight, cross-platform programmer's text editor and IDE with syntax support for more than 50 programming languages.
use_cases: Editing source code in many programming languages
Editing config files, SQL and diff output
Writing Python, C, Java, PHP or JavaScript
Customizing editor with themes and plugins
summary.what_it_does: Geany is described as a powerful, stable and lightweight programmer's text editor with a GUI. It runs on Linux, Windows and macOS and is translated into over 40 languages. It has built-in support for more than 50 programming languages, including C, Java, PHP, HTML, JavaScript, Python and Perl, plus other filetypes such as ini-style config files, diff output and SQL. Color themes and new filetypes can be customized, and a plugin system lets users add or improve features. It is released under the GPL v2 license.
notable: Built-in support for more than 50 programming languages
caveats: The page lists a call for a new maintainer for the Windows builds of Geany (January 2025), so Windows build upkeep may be uncertain.
